page.overview:
Who is Tour Aryon?

Tour Aryon was the Human female who served as governor of the desert planet Tatooine under the Galactic Empire. She was a native from Treylon II.

Tour Aryon was born on the planet Treylon II. She met and married her husband, Kant, the son of a wealthy baron and baroness. He was a con artist who moved in underworld circles, but recanted the life so as not to jeopardize Aryon's political career when she was appointed as Tatooine's Imperial governor. Upon her arrival, Aryon moved her offices into a palatial house located in Bestine, and immediately appointed Orun Depp as Imperial Prefect. She placed him in charge of running Tatooine's day-to-day affairs.

Aryon's contributions to Tatooine focused on the cultural, much of which was lost on the average Tatooinian. She established a museum in Bestine, which boasted the only complete Krayt dragon skeleton on the planet, and hosted lavish garden parties with expensive, imported entertainment. Aryon did not respect the citizens of Mos Eisley, considering them to be peasants and savages.

When Darth Vader sent his own stormtroopers to the surface of Tatooine to search for R2-D2 and C-3PO, Tour objected, insisting that her own troops could handle it. When Vader was informed of her objections, he did not care. After Imperial Prefect Orun Depp was assassinated by the assassin droid IG-72, Governor Tour replaced him with Eugene Talmont.
